name: HCTF Habitat Acquisition Grants
summary: Grants for land trusts, community organisations and First Nations to buy private land in British Columbia as protected fish and wildlife habitat. From 2026 only fee-simple purchases qualify, not covenants.

status.quote: The Habitat Acquisition Grant is now closed. The next opportunity to apply will be early 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Habitat Acquisition Grants provide funding to land trusts, community organizations, and First Nations for the purchase of private properties

geography.quote: for the purchase of private properties to protect important habitat for B.C.'s fish and wildlife

access.quote: Submission of Habitat Acquisition Grant Applications is through the HCTF Survey Apply system.

window.quote: The Habitat Acquisition Grant is now closed. The next opportunity to apply will be early 2027.
